_comment: ORNL Flexible Research Platform (FRP-2) rooftop weather station -> CAMBER Role mapping (Weather_<scenario>.csv): outdoor dry-bulb (degC, declared on the entry) and relative humidity. Solar, wind and barometric pressure have no role. Dataset: ORNL FRP operation scenarios (CC-BY-4.0), doi:10.1038/s41597-022-01858-6.
